actual: Manual nightly run 28016507522 completed the code-intelligence and new LLM silent degradation audit steps, but the final Nightly summary + auto-bug on failure job failed in step 'Close stale Nightly failure issues after recovery'. The step runs 'python scripts/aistock_issue_workflow.py ci-issue-janitor --superseded-only --apply --stdout-format compact' in GitHub Actions without GH_TOKEN, so gh exits with: 'To use GitHub CLI in a GitHub Actions workflow, set the GH_TOKEN environment variable.' Fix nightly.yml so the janitor step has the required GitHub token while preserving least privilege and warning-only behavior.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
